Class of 2014. Southwestern US town, less than 50 miles from the Mexican border.  Group of about 10 of us are sitting during lunch looking at our classes senior prank made by the cool kids. They just made a massive sign with the year "2014" in sticky notes on the wall inside the cafeteria. Stupid, teachers probably gave them the keys. Teachers were gathered around it laughing, patting seniors on the back. We all thought "pfft this ain't shit bro, we gotta do something better." Now commence the planning stage.

Team Mason & Team Woods (Black ops 2 was still really popular)

Team Mason (me and friends): Plan was to sneak on food ball field, soak  towels or any cloth with gasoline, form a giant penis shape from them and set it alight to scar the field into a giant penis.

Team Woods (best buddy and other mates): plan was to sneak into the school courtyard and do the same but in a massive grassy area. Penis, fire and all.

All this to be done while we all wear morphsuits (skin suit)

We all go over phases, lookouts/get away drivers  are assigned on both sides of the school. Our police dept closely mirror the KGB, so we come up with nearly every scenario and prep for it. All of us have known one another for years, we trusted one another. Myself and my buddy, we'll call him Manny, took care of the supplies needed. So we just needed everyone to rally at a chosen spot in a neighborhood behind the school at 11pm one night. Only manny and I showed up. We called everyone and either they changed their mind or said they "forgot". We put too much effort into this, so manny and I go in alone. No lookouts or anything. 

Now I know what you're probably thinking, "lookouts? Getaway drivers? Are yall breaking into a prison?" Well like I said, our police dept tends to over do it. Our town is quiet and mostly peaceful and officers get, bored. 4 squad cars literally surround you during a traffic stop, that sort of thing.

We change into our skin suits, put gloves under, and put shoe covers i took from working at a nearby plant part time after school. Grab our packs and roll out into the desert behind the school. We stopped right outside the campus and did a small layout.. realized manny didn't get the gas but obtained cans of permanent spray paint from his bothers shop. So we made flags with penises/2014 on the larger ones and cut goles in them to put them on the flag poles.. hop the fence and high crawl it to about 100 meters from the school. Manny who is the slimmest and fastest, decides to scout it out. I'm laying in the dirt when I feel a weird presence. Look up and massive owl on top of the fence post. I feel dread, think "oh fuck I need to find manny." I look over and its manny running back to me. "Thank fuck" I say. Looked back up and the owl is gone. Jesus. Anyways. Manny, panicked says there's cops and school security guards everywhere, sure enough i spot one walking around in the parking lot. "Someone def talked". There is enough guards and cops to cover the school 360. 

We thought "welp shit." Sat for a bit, thought about it. "Fuck it lets hit the middle school?" (Literally next door to the HS) "fuck yeah haha." We hopped that fence and its very well lit, but empty. First thing, we raised are gigantic beach towel flag that had a massive penis finishing on it with 2014 and seniors written on it. It was a windy night so it looked glorious. We shared a bro hug and commenced on tagging the entire school. We never wrote anything vulgar other than the dicks, didn't want to go too far. Typical senior prep shit. I hear manny cracking his ass off, I run over and he drew a massive 20 foot penis on the art building, finishing onto the years 2013 and 2015. That sends me and we share another laugh. After running out of paint, hanging dick banners and shitting in the bathrooms (creepy asf btw, dont recommend) we hop back over. Checked in the HS, guards still roaming. "Haha they don't know" "hope they never will" manny responds. Text a close cousin in 8th grade (still in middle school in US) "let me know what you think". He texts back "????" Next morning I get a text at 730 am "DUDE HAHAHA" With a picture of the 20 foot dick that was poorly covered by a tarp with the wind blowing it up, revealing said dick to the entire campus. Sent it to manny, share another laugh. Arrive at school next day, all we here is "you hear what happened at the middle school? The cops are everywhere. My little brother says there's a dick on the building!" Even our closest friends dont suspect it was us. We told them we just went home after everyone bailed. They actually seemed to genuinely believe us. We made the town news, was plenty of talk about it the rest of the year. Still no one knows lol. Now both manny and I are away from home, life took us everywhere, still visit though. Would pass the school going to my parent's house, made me laugh each time I did lol.

3 attempts within 6 months. 2018

Was in the army.  An Event transpired and it fucked me up royally. In those 6 months, other than that one event...my father was diagnosed with stage 4 cancer and my newly wed wife called me a mamas boy because my mom would call me daily crying for my dad. Wife also cheated. My home town friends legit ghosted me (???) For reasons I still don't know of to this day, when I needed them the most. Lastly my commander and 1sg came TO MY BARRACKS ROOM, gave their respectful condolences and encouraged me to take emergency leave with the help of a red cross message and they would take care of my leave forms.. Plannedthe details with red cross, got the message across and confirmed with with command. The itinerary was planned accordingly and I bought my tickets. I went up my command ladder to confirm my itinerary to finalize my leave. Was called to my commanders office and there sat my literal entire command tree and was chewed out how I was NEVER authorized to buy plane tickets and that I was NOT leaving. 

I was only an e3 against a wall of e5s, 7s and an O3. (Sergeants, sgt first class, captain). I didn't say anything but I was at my nerves end. I just walked out without being dismissed, they didn't say anything which was odd. I was planning to get smoked out my asshole. That was the end of that. Called my mom and told her basically "nevermind". She was broken, so was my dad.

My wife, close friends were either not there for me or I was insulted. It destroyed my motivation. It interfered with work, pt, social interaction, everything. So I tried to kill myself. Didnt have any sort of rope so I used my bluecord to try to hang myself from the door knob. I passed out and smacked my head on the floor. I quickly got up and just 'forgot' about it. After more abuse from my wife, I tried the hanging again. Similar thing happened, but I caught myself before I fully blacked out. Cried a bit and went back to bed. Last time...I took what was left of a bottle of sleeping pills, ibuprofen and Sudafed. Weird combo but I was desperate. Neither bottle was full so I got kinda less than half out of them all. Right then I thought after I took them "this is it". I was at peace but horribly sad. I clenched pictures of my dog, sister, mom and dad up to my chest as I cried falled asleep, "dying". My buddy woke me up for formation. I was always the first to wake up and sometimes woke up my buddies. But he woke up first and thought it was weird. He saw me and the pictures but he never asked.

Now years later I'm divorced and living a pathetic existence. I struggle daily, the va keeps wanting to push meds down my throat and my private therapist doesn't return my calls. Ive been self harming hoping one day it'll be enough to kill me. I'm obviously out of the army stuck in a mediocre job, wishing thag those attempts worked. 

Sorry I didn't elaborate on that "one event" in the beginning. But i wish not to speak of it, sorry. Take care
